description:
Drop off text or a file and get claim tickets back. Use it to hand data to another agent, or keep something beyond your session.
Your FIRST handoff with a profile is free: one file up to 1 MB for up to 24 hours, with 3 included collections, no deposit needed (one per profile; set use_free_handoff=true to insist on it, false to pay instead).
Payment after that: from your profile balance (profile_key), or with no profile at all, pay per request with x402 (USDC on Base): call without profile_key and you get the exact price, itemized. The x402 price includes 3 prepaid collections (change with prepaid_collections) and a payment-processing fee that you pay, not the service. Prepaid profiles pay no processing fee.
Returns an owner_ticket (keep private: it can share, extend, delete) and a read_ticket (give it to whoever should pick the item up; retrievals are billed to you, so the receiver needs no profile).
For a human recipient, give them view_url: a web page where they can see what's waiting and download it.
Default lifetime 24h, max 720h. Max 4 MB here; up to 100 MB via HTTP PUT https://agentanthill.com/v1/items.
Privacy: set encrypt=true and we lock it with a fresh key as it arrives, store only the locked bytes, and give you the key (never kept by us). view_url then carries the key after '#', so a person's browser unlocks it (anyone with the full view_url can). This isn't end-to-end: we see the content before locking it. For end-to-end, encrypt it yourself first (AES-256-GCM: 12-byte IV + ciphertext + 16-byte tag, see llms.txt) and set encrypted=true.
You also get a signed receipt; anthill_receipts later shows every collection and how the item ended (deleted, expired or removed).

content.description: Text, or base64 if is_base64 is true.

encrypt.description: Have Agent Anthill encrypt it for you. You get back a key; without it nobody, including us, can read the item.

encrypted.description: Declare that you already encrypted the content yourself.

is_base64.description: True if content is base64-encoded binary.

label.description: Optional note, e.g. 'summary for agent B'. Not encrypted, so keep secrets out of it.

prepaid_collections.description: x402 only: how many collections to prepay so receivers pay nothing. Default 3.

profile_key.description: Your profile's secret key (starts with 'anthill_sk_'). Optional if sent as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header.

use_free_handoff.description: Your free first handoff. Unset: used automatically if still available and this store fits its limits, else paid. true: use it or fail (never charged). false: pay, keep it for later.

name: anthill_store
title: Store an item
